description: Hire a senior backend engineer for a 12-person Series A startup. Must ship core API rewrite within 2 months. Budget capped at $160k base.

constraints.label: Deep Backend Systems Experience (Go/PostgreSQL)
constraints.description: Must be able to architect and ship a high-throughput API rewrite in Go with PostgreSQL from day one.

constraints.label: Can Mentor Junior Engineers
constraints.description: Team has 3 junior engineers. This hire must elevate the team, not just write code.

constraints.label: Base Salary <= $160k
constraints.description: Series A runway is tight. Base compensation must not exceed $160k.

constraints.label: Can Start Within 4 Weeks
constraints.description: The API rewrite must begin within 2 months. A 3-month notice period would miss the window.

constraints.label: Comfortable With Ambiguity and Small-Team Chaos
constraints.description: Startup environment. Requirements shift weekly. Must thrive without rigid processes.

constraints.label: Fintech or Payments Domain Experience
constraints.description: Nice to have. The product handles payment processing. Domain familiarity reduces ramp-up.

options.label: Candidate A - Senior Go Engineer at Stripe (7 YOE)

capabilities.note: 7 years in Go. Built payment processing pipelines at Stripe. Deep PostgreSQL experience.
Has mentored 2 junior engineers informally. No formal tech lead experience. Willing but untested.
Current comp is $195k base. Expects at least $185k. Significantly over budget.
Has a 4-week notice period at Stripe. Could potentially negotiate to 3 weeks but not guaranteed.
Coming from a large, well-structured engineering org. Enthusiastic about startup life but untested.
3 years on Stripe payments team. Deep fintech domain knowledge.

options.label: Candidate B - Backend Lead at Series B Startup (5 YOE)

capabilities.note: 5 years backend, last 3 in Go. Led API rewrite at current startup from monolith to microservices.
Currently leads a team of 4 engineers. Conducts code reviews, runs architecture sessions, mentors actively.
Currently at $135k. Asking $155k. Within budget with room for equity negotiation.
2-week notice period. Can start within 3 weeks.
Currently at a 20-person startup. Comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities.
Current startup is in logistics, not fintech. Understands transactional systems but no direct payments experience.

options.label: Candidate C - Staff Engineer at Big Tech (10 YOE)

capabilities.note: 10 years backend. Expert in distributed systems. Go is one of several languages. PostgreSQL at massive scale.
Staff-level. Has led cross-team initiatives of 15+ engineers. Strong mentorship track record.
Current total comp is $320k. Base expectation is $180k+. Over budget.
Requires 6-week notice plus planned 3-week vacation. Earliest start is 9 weeks out. Misses the window.
Entire career at companies with 10,000+ employees. Interview signals suggest discomfort with lack of process.
Worked on a payments platform at Big Tech for 2 years. Understands compliance and ledger design.
